_doc: Surveillance asset detection database. Used by Sonar's probe-request pipeline (T-0166) and Beacon Watch's BLE pipeline (T-0167). Override locally at /etc/phantom/surveillance-vendors.json. Discipline: every entry must cite a public source. OUI prefixes are operationally observed, not necessarily IEEE-registered to the named vendor — fleet-rotation and reuse across product lines is normal. Prefer empty over false-positive.

vendors.name: Flock Safety
vendors.description: Automated license-plate reader. Pole-mounted, solar/battery powered, cellular backhaul. Emits a wildcard probe-request from one of the listed OUI prefixes; older units also broadcast BLE manufacturer ID 0x09C8.

vendors.name: ShotSpotter Raven
vendors.description: SoundThinking/ShotSpotter Raven gunshot-detection microphone. Often co-located with Flock cameras on city light poles. Advertises a distinctive set of 16-bit BLE service UUIDs.
